0.original: Maqali's son should have returned by now.

49.original: I am sorry to trouble you, but could I ask you to check on my son? I sent him to the Dawn Throne on an errand and he should have returned by now.

50.original: Word has it that there are some Oronir who resent the fact that our tribe triumphed in the Naadam. I worry that one of them may have done something to my boy.

51.original: Please ask Chagur as to my son's whereabouts. She should know if he is safe or not. I do hope I am worrying for nothing...

54.original: Please ask Chagur as to my son's whereabouts. She should know if he is safe or not. I do hope I am worrying for nothing...

55.original: Ah, khagan. To what do we owe the pleasure?

56.original: Yes, Maqali's son was here just a short while ago. The last I saw he was heading westwards with some hunters.

57.original: I do not imagine there is aught to worry about, but check on him by all means should you be concerned.

59.original: I do not imagine there is aught to worry about, but check on him by all means should you be concerned. He was headed off to the west the last time I saw him.

60.original: <pant> <pant> I cannot continue. My hands are covered in blisters. Wait, you are the khagan, are you not? What brings you here?

61.original: Father was truly that worried? After completing my errand, I began talking with these hunters, and they invited me to train with them.

62.original: I had always looked down on the Mol, but it was we who lost. There must be some secret to their strength. Come on, let us go another round!

63.original: My apologies but Father awaits my return. Perhaps I can join you again when my hands are not so sore. Thank you for the invitation.

65.original: He must be hiding his true strength from us. There is no way we could have been defeated by such a weak tribe.

67.original: I just spoke with my son. I could not ask him too much as he was keen to hurry off and get his hands bandaged up. What exactly happened?

68.original: Ha ha, truly? No doubt the experience will serve him well.

69.original: Perhaps that kind of training is exactly what he needs to become a strong warrior like yourself. He may not like it, but he shall need to suffer if he wants to grow stronger.
